title: Facility Engineer (Entry Level)
description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet. 
 

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

Joining our operations team means being at the center of everything – maintaining and evolving critical infrastructure that powers the digital world and delivers real impact for our customers, communities and society. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Join a Global Leader in Digital Infrastructure

We are looking for a hands-on Facility Engineer to join our new SG6 site in Singapore. This is an excellent opportunity for candidates who enjoy troubleshooting electrical or mechanical systems and want to build a long-term career in a critical infrastructure environment.

What You'll Do

As a Facility Engineer, you will help ensure the safe and reliable operation of building infrastructure and support systems.

Key Responsibilities

Facility Operations & Maintenance

  • Perform preventative maintenance checks on facility equipment and systems
  • Conduct routine repairs, maintenance and installations
  • Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and respond to alarms
  • Support troubleshooting and corrective maintenance activities
  • Assist with the operation of electrical, mechanical, plumbing, fire protection and safety systems
  • Escalate and support resolution of facility issues and incidents

Vendor & Site Support

  • Coordinate with external service providers and contractors
  • Support maintenance activities and ensure work is completed safely
  • Review and follow maintenance procedures and work permits
  • Maintain site logs and operational documentation

Projects & Collaboration

  • Complete work orders and support infrastructure projects
  • Assist senior engineers with facility upgrades and incident response
  • Collaborate with team members to maintain site reliability and uptime

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related technical discipline
  • Internship experience or 1+ years of hands-on experience maintaining electrical or mechanical equipment
  • Experience gained in facilities such as:
    • Hospitals
    • Commercial buildings
    • Shopping malls
    • Manufacturing facilities
    • Airports
    • Industrial plants
    • Facilities management environments
  • Strong interest in troubleshooting and fixing equipment issues
  • Comfortable working in a hands-on operational environment
  • Able to work rotating 12-hour shifts (including nights, weekends and public holidays)
  • Must have unrestricted working rights in Singapore (Singapore Citizen, PR, or other valid work authorization that does not require sponsorship)
  • Able to work on-site at SG6 (Jalan Tukang area)

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to electrical distribution systems, UPS, generators, HVAC, chillers or mechanical systems
  • Experience using Building Management Systems (BMS)
  • Understanding of safety procedures and permit-to-work processes

Why Join Equinix?

  • Work for a global industry leader with operations across the world
  • Be part of a brand-new data center facility
  • Comprehensive training provided on critical facility infrastructure
  • Long-term career growth opportunities in engineering and operations
  • Exposure to cutting-edge technology and mission-critical environments
